title.zh: 计数表是计数的全部规律：计数表恰是平衡加上跨一步不再成立的不多于步前所列的，每个计数表都由一个队列实现；在八个前提的每个选择之下，计数的规律恰是计数表，或者再加上没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起，后者恰在选择包含平衡、体现，以及只有活跃者给予或只有活跃者取用与耗散时成立；每个前提都起约束时，八个前提之下计数的规律只多出有某个生起；每个选择之下所选前提都起约束时，至多再加三条：有关系项活跃、有某个生起、在有关系项活跃的一步上有生起，每条恰在何种选择之下多出已刻画；有限世界中除普查外每个前提都起约束时只多出有某个生起
title.en: The tally is the whole law of counting: the tally is exactly the balance with no more ceasing across a step than were listed before it, and every tally is counted by a queue; under each selection of the eight premises the laws of counting are the tally, or the tally and that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, the latter exactly where balance and embodiment are selected with only active relata giving, or with only active relata taking and dissipation; where every premise binds, the laws of counting under the eight add only that something arises; where the premises of each selection bind, at most three more: something active, something arising, and something arising across a step at which something is active, each characterized by exactly the selections adding it; in finite worlds where every premise but the census binds, only that something arises

claim.zh: 一个规定每步的成立者被不重复地列出（Listed）且可判定时，跨每一步保持一些成员：它们连同跨步不再成立的成员是步前的列表，连同跨步开始成立的成员是步后的列表（Listed.keeps；普查的平衡 Listed.across 由此推出）。称每步的数目 n、跨步不再成立的数目 c 与开始成立的数目 a 为计数表（Tally），若每步有某数 k 使 n t = k + c t 且 n (t+1) = k + a t；每个列出的计数都是计数表（Listed.tally）。计数表严格强于普查的平衡 n (t+1) + c t = n t + a t（Balance，Listed.across 的等式）：计数表恰是平衡加上跨一步不再成立的不多于步前所列的（Tally.balance、Tally.ceasing_le、tally_iff）；每步零个在列、一个不再成立、一个开始成立满足平衡而不是计数表（balance_not_tally）。反过来，每个计数表都由一个队列实现：自然数作为成员，第 t 步在队中的是从此前离开的总数起的 n t 个，从队尾加入、从队首离开，各依其次（Queue.holds、Queue.line）；它被不重复地列出（Queue.listed），每步列出 n t 个，跨步离开 c t 个、加入 a t 个（Queue.counts）。所以列出所能有的计数恰是计数表（Tally.congr、tally_iff_counted），对计数的一个性质（只要求尊重每步的值，Pointwise），在每个类型上每个列出的计数都满足它，恰当每个计数表都满足它（counting_laws）：计数没有计数表之外的规律。读于世界的活动：成员排队而什么都不流动的世界满足除体现外的全部前提（活动需要支持、平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用其所汲取的、耗散、普查、有界传递；World.queue_premised），成员排队且恰在活跃时立着的世界满足除平衡外的全部前提（World.embodiedQueue_premised）；所以对计数的一个性质在每个世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个计数表成立，也恰当它在满足除体现外全部前提的每个世界中成立，也恰当它在满足除平衡外全部前提的每个世界中成立（World.counting_free）：缺平衡或缺体现的前提不约束计数。两者连同只有活跃者给予一起约束：在平衡、只有活跃者给予且生起者体现的世界中，生起者由一个在该步活跃的关系项给予（Web.Embodied.arises_given），所以普查之下，没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起；而一个关系项从无到有地生起（Queue.lone_tally）是计数表，由两个队列世界实现，所以这不是计数的规律（World.counting_binds_jointly）。八个前提所加的只有这一条：开放的队列，队首给予每个加入者一个单位、从每个离开者取用一个单位，活跃时与每个地关系项各交换一个单位（World.openQueue），在没有成员加入空队的每个计数表之下满足全部八个前提（World.openQueue_premised；队首活跃的步上没有有限家族封闭，队空的步上什么都不交换，所以耗散从不起约束，活动需要支持与有界传递也不起约束，World.openQueue_not_binds）；所以对计数的一个性质在满足全部八个前提的每个世界的普查中成立，恰当它对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起的计数表成立（World.premised_counting）；这一刻画的范围包括前提空成立的世界：在每个前提都起约束的世界中，每个普查都计到某个生起（World.binds_arising），而这在八个前提之下不是计数的规律（World.binds_adds）。约束计数还有第二条路线，不要求给予者活跃：在平衡、只有活跃者取用其所汲取的、耗散且关系项都体现的世界中，普查之下没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起，不论谁给予（World.taking_binds_counting）：那一步上什么都不被取用，被给予的立起而在步后活跃，所以步后活跃者是一个封闭的家族，耗散不许不取用而给予它。把八个前提命名（World.Premise、Premise.Holds），一个选择是到 Bool 的函数，世界满足它所选的每个前提（World.Meets）；称一个选择约束计数（World.BindsCounting），若它选中平衡与体现，并选中只有活跃者给予，或同时选中只有活跃者取用与耗散。由一个从不活跃的地关系项驱动的队列（OpenQueue.driven、World.drivenQueue）不论计数都满足除只有活跃者给予与只有活跃者取用外的全部前提（World.drivenQueue_holds），开放的队列不论计数都满足除只有活跃者给予与耗散外的全部前提（World.openQueue_holds）；连同两个队列世界，它们满足每个不约束计数的选择（World.queue_meets、World.embodiedQueue_meets、World.openQueue_meets、World.drivenQueue_meets），满足全部八个前提的世界满足每个选择（World.Premised.meets）。所以在八个前提的 256 个选择的每一个之下，对计数的一个逐点的性质在满足这个选择的每个世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个计数表成立，且在选择约束计数时对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起的计数表成立（World.counting_under）；“没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起”在一个选择之下是计数的规律，恰当这个选择约束计数（World.counting_binds_iff）。每个前提都起约束，即每个前提的条件都有实例时（World.Premise.Binds 是一个前提起约束，World.Binds 是每个前提都起约束），每个普查都计到某个生起（World.binds_arising），而起约束所加的只有这一条：只闭合一次的队列（OnceClosedQueue、World.onceClosedQueue）在除第 T 步外、步前或步后队列不空的每一步上，队首与每个关系项各交换一个单位，所以没有有限的家族封闭这些步；在第 T 步上队首多立着 E，只在队中交换并失去它，所以所立者下降，跨度封闭这一步而耗散起约束（World.onceClosedQueue_exceeds）；每个关系项以其所立的水平依存于每个关系项，所以活动需要支持与有界传递的条件在有成员加入处有实例；但这两个前提在这里对任何活动、任何流都成立（OnceClosedQueue.dependent_any_activity、OnceClosedQueue.transmits_any_flow），只在有实例的意义上起约束，排除什么的只有耗散。没有成员加入空队、E 多于第 T 步加入的数目时，它满足全部八个前提（World.onceClosedQueue_premised）；第 T 步队列不空、E 多于第 T 步加入的数目且某步有成员加入时，每个前提都起约束（World.onceClosedQueue_binds），不论有没有成员加入空队。所以在每个前提都起约束的世界中，八个前提之下对计数的一个逐点的性质在每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个有某个生起、且没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起的计数表成立（World.binding_counting）。没有有限世界使每个前提都起约束（World.Finite.not_binds：普查起约束要求世界不有限）；去掉 hatch 闲置的地关系项，得到满足八个前提的有限世界，其中除普查外每个前提都起约束（World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census）。有限世界中除普查外每个前提都起约束时，八个前提之下对计数的一个逐点的性质在每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起、从第 0 步起有变化界、且有某个生起的计数表成立（World.finite_binding_counting）；见证是有限的队列把依存网饱和（Web.saturated、World.finiteQueue_saturated_binds）。每个选择 S 之下，对计数的一个逐点的性质在满足 S 且 S 所选的每个前提都起约束的每个世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个这样的计数表成立：S 约束计数时没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起；S 选中活动需要支持、只有活跃者给予或只有活跃者取用时有关系项活跃；S 选中体现时有某个生起；S 选中体现、只有活跃者给予与有界传递时在有关系项活跃的一步上有生起（World.binding_counting_under）。所以起约束所加的，恰是有关系项活跃（选中活动需要支持、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用或体现时，World.binding_activity_iff）、有某个生起（选中体现时，World.binding_arising_iff）与在有关系项活跃的一步上有生起（选中体现，且选择约束计数或选中只有活跃者给予与有界传递时，World.binding_joint_iff）。见证：把依存网饱和，每个关系项以其所立的水平依存于每个关系项，活动需要支持就对任何活动成立，水平有界时有界传递对任何流成立（Web.saturated、World.Premised.saturated）；不选体现时，一个传递在队列旁把两个单位之一交给一个地关系项，失去另一个（World.relayQueue_binding）；选中体现而不选平衡时，有损的队列的队首跨一步与自身及每个加入者各交换一个单位，再失去一个单位，所立者不记录这些（World.lossyQueue_binding）；选中平衡与体现时，只闭合一次的队列（World.onceClosedQueue_binding）与饱和的开放队列（World.openQueue_saturated_binding）。被围住时计数还受一个变化界约束；有限世界中每个选择之下计数还有界，耗散连同平衡与体现就约束计数（counting-under-enclosure）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Where the members of which a determination holds are listed at each step, each once (Listed), and the determination is decided, across each step some members are kept: with the members ceasing to be across it they are the list before the step, and with the members coming to be the list after it (Listed.keeps; the census balance Listed.across follows from it). Call counts n at each step, c ceasing and a coming across it a tally (Tally) when at each step some number k has n t = k + c t and n (t + 1) = k + a t; the counts of every listing are a tally (Listed.tally). The tally is strictly stronger than the census balance n (t + 1) + c t = n t + a t (Balance, the equation of Listed.across): it is exactly the balance with no more ceasing across a step than were listed before it (Tally.balance, Tally.ceasing_le, tally_iff), and none listed with one ceasing and one coming at every step balances and is no tally (balance_not_tally). Conversely every tally is counted by a queue: with natural numbers as members, at step t the queue holds n t members from the number that have left before, members joining at the back and leaving from the front, each in turn (Queue.holds, Queue.line); it is listed, each member once (Queue.listed), with n t listed at each step, c t leaving and a t joining across it (Queue.counts). So the counts some listing has are exactly the tallies (Tally.congr, tally_iff_counted), and a property of the counts, asked only to respect their values at each step (Pointwise), holds of the counts of every listing on every type exactly when it holds of every tally (counting_laws): counting has no law beyond the tally. Read of the activity of worlds: relata queuing with nothing flowing meet every premise but embodiment (activity needing support, balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking what they draw on, dissipation, a census, bounded transmission; World.queue_premised), and relata queuing that stand exactly while active meet every premise but balance (World.embodiedQueue_premised); so a property of the counts holds of every census of every world exactly when it holds of every tally, and exactly when it holds in every world meeting every premise but embodiment, and exactly when it holds in every world meeting every premise but balance (World.counting_free): premises lacking balance or embodiment leave counting free. With only active relata giving, the two bind it together: in a world whose flow balances, in which only active relata give and whatever arises is embodied, what arises is given by a relatum active at the step (Web.Embodied.arises_given), so under a census nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active; one relatum arising from none (Queue.lone_tally) is a tally, counted by both queue worlds, so this is no law of counting (World.counting_binds_jointly). That is all the eight premises add: an open queue, whose front gives one unit to each relatum joining, takes one from each leaving and, while active, exchanges a unit each way with every ground relatum (World.openQueue), meets all eight premises under every tally in which nothing joins an empty queue (World.openQueue_premised; no finite family is closed at a step at which the front is active, and nothing is exchanged at a step at which the queue is empty, so dissipation never binds there, nor do activity needing support and bounded transmission, World.openQueue_not_binds); so a property of the counts holds of the census of every world meeting all eight exactly when it holds of every tally in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active (World.premised_counting); its range includes worlds in which premises hold vacuously: where every premise binds, every census counts something arising (World.binds_arising), which is no law of counting under the eight (World.binds_adds). A second route binds counting without asking the giver to be active: in a world whose flow balances and dissipates, in which only active relata take and only from what they draw on and every relatum is embodied, under a census nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, whoever gives (World.taking_binds_counting): nothing is taken at that step, whatever is given comes to stand and is active after it, so the relata active after it form a closed family, to which dissipation lets nothing be given without taking. With the eight premises named (World.Premise, Premise.Holds), a selection is a function to Bool, and a world meets it when it meets every premise selected (World.Meets); a selection binds counting (World.BindsCounting) when it selects balance and embodiment, and either only active relata giving or both only active relata taking and dissipation. Whatever its counts, a queue driven by a ground relatum never active (OpenQueue.driven, World.drivenQueue) meets every premise but only active relata giving and taking (World.drivenQueue_holds), and the open queue every premise but only active relata giving and dissipation (World.openQueue_holds); with the two queue worlds they meet every selection that does not bind counting (World.queue_meets, World.embodiedQueue_meets, World.openQueue_meets, World.drivenQueue_meets), and a world meeting all eight meets every selection (World.Premised.meets). So under each of the 256 selections of the eight premises, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every world meeting the selection exactly when it holds of every tally and, where the selection binds counting, of every tally in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active (World.counting_under); that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active is a law of counting under a selection exactly when the selection binds counting (World.counting_binds_iff). Where every premise binds, each premise's condition having an instance (World.Premise.Binds for one premise, World.Binds for every premise), every census counts something arising (World.binds_arising), and that is all binding adds. Across every step but T at which a queue closed once (OnceClosedQueue, World.onceClosedQueue) is not empty before or after, its front exchanges one unit each way with every relatum, so no finite family closes those steps; at T the front stands E more, exchanges only within the queue and loses that excess, so what stands falls, the span closes the step and dissipation binds (World.onceClosedQueue_exceeds); every relatum depends on every relatum at what it stands at, so the conditions of activity needing support and bounded transmission have instances wherever a member joins; but there these two premises hold whatever is active and whatever flows (OnceClosedQueue.dependent_any_activity, OnceClosedQueue.transmits_any_flow), binding only as instances, and only dissipation excludes anything. With nothing joining an empty queue and E more than join across T it meets all eight premises (World.onceClosedQueue_premised); with the queue not empty at T, E more than join across T and something joining across some step, every premise binds (World.onceClosedQueue_binds), whether or not something joins an empty queue. So in worlds in which every premise binds, a pointwise property of the counts holds under the eight of every census exactly when it holds of every tally with something arising and nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active (World.binding_counting). No finite world binds every premise (World.Finite.not_binds: a census binds only where the world is not finite); without the idle ground of hatch there is a finite world meeting the eight in which every premise but the census binds (World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census). In finite worlds where every premise but the census binds, a pointwise property of the counts holds under the eight of every census exactly when it holds of every tally with nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active, a change bound from the first step and something arising (World.finite_binding_counting), the finite queue with its web saturated witnessing it (Web.saturated, World.finiteQueue_saturated_binds). Under each selection S, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every world meeting S in which each premise S selects binds exactly when it holds of every tally in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active where S binds counting, something is active where S selects activity needing support, only active relata giving or only active relata taking, something arises where S selects embodiment, and something arises across a step at which something is active where S selects embodiment, only active relata giving and bounded transmission (World.binding_counting_under). So binding adds exactly that something is active (where activity needing support, only active relata giving, only active relata taking or embodiment is selected, World.binding_activity_iff), that something arises (where embodiment is, World.binding_arising_iff), and that something arises across a step at which something is active (where embodiment is selected and the selection binds counting or selects only active relata giving and bounded transmission, World.binding_joint_iff). The witnesses: a saturated web, every relatum depending on every relatum at what it stands at, under which activity needing support holds whatever is active and, with levels bounded, bounded transmission whatever flows (Web.saturated, World.Premised.saturated); without embodiment, a relay beside a queue handing one of two units on to a ground relatum and losing the other (World.relayQueue_binding); with embodiment but not balance, a lossy queue whose front, across one step, exchanges a unit each way with itself and each member joining and loses one unit more, which no standing records (World.lossyQueue_binding); with balance and embodiment, the queue closed once (World.onceClosedQueue_binding) and the open queue with its web saturated (World.openQueue_saturated_binding). Under enclosure change is also bounded; in finite worlds under each selection the count is bounded too, and dissipation with balance and embodiment binds counting (counting-under-enclosure). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 列出与可判定：同 census-balance；读于世界时是活动可判定。这是表示的逻辑承诺。
hypotheses.en: Listing and decidability: as in census-balance; read of worlds, decided activity. It is a logical commitment of the representation.

hypotheses.zh: 逐点（Pointwise）：性质尊重计数每步的值。有函数外延性时每个性质都如此；纯净核心不假设它，所以作为定理的假设陈述；不用它的刻画是 tally_iff_counted。
hypotheses.en: Pointwise: the property respects the counts' values at each step. With function extensionality every property does; the pure core does not assume it, so it is a hypothesis of the theorems; tally_iff_counted states the characterization without it.

correspondence.zh: 完整的陈述（P23）说，整体的规律除了表示本身所排除的，不排除任何展开。对计数，本结果使这一点精确：计数的规律不排除任何计数表，所以从计数本身推不出关于展开的任何更多的东西。开放纲领中的“对整个空间成立的规律的完整清单”在计数的部分由此给出。前提的地图（map-of-premises）表明八个前提彼此独立；本结果说明它们中的哪些约束计数、约束什么：在 256 个选择的每一个之下计数的规律只有两种，缺平衡或缺体现的任何一组都不约束，两者连同只有活跃者给予，或连同只有活跃者取用与耗散，约束同一条，而全部八个所加的也只有这一条，即使每个都起约束，也只多出有某个生起，这一条来自体现起约束的条件本身；更多的约束来自被围住：静止定理（ceasing-needs-arising、continued-change-needs-openness）在被围住之下使计数归于静止，被围住时计数的全部规律再加一个变化界（counting-under-enclosure）。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在场者的数目只记录进入与离开相抵；展开怎样改变这些数目，来自给予与取用的关系，即平衡与体现一起所说的：生起需要一个在场的给予者；或者，在只有活跃者取用与耗散之下，一个封闭的关系不能不取用而给予，生起需要从在场者那里取得。这是活动的计数，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；它是否为 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”由 Ren 选择（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠；若取不重叠，这一读法就不是其所指，这是 AI 的推论）；它也不评价生起或止息。
correspondence.en: The full statement (P23) says that the laws of the whole exclude no unfolding beyond what the representation itself excludes. For counting this result makes it precise: the laws of counting exclude no tally, so nothing more about an unfolding follows from counting alone. The open programme's ‘complete list of the laws holding of the whole space’ is thereby given for counting. The map of premises (map-of-premises) shows the eight premises independent; this result says which of them constrain counting, and how: under each of the 256 selections the laws of counting are of two kinds; no set lacking balance or embodiment constrains it, the two with only active relata giving, or with only active relata taking and dissipation, add the same law, and all eight add nothing more, and with each of them binding only that something arises, which comes from the condition of embodiment binding by itself; further constraint comes from enclosure: under it the rest theorem (ceasing-needs-arising, continued-change-needs-openness) brings counting to rest, and the whole law of counting under enclosure adds a change bound (counting-under-enclosure). The author's reading (an AI argument): the number present records only that entering and leaving balance; how an unfolding changes these numbers comes from the relations of giving and taking, which is what balance and embodiment say together: arising needs a giver present; or, with only active relata taking and dissipation, a closed relation cannot give without taking, and arising needs a taking from what is present. This is the counting of activity, whose English names arising and ceasing Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names; the Chinese 生起／止息 being the AI's rendering); whether it is the proposal's generative and degenerative is Ren's to choose (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap; if non-overlap is taken, this reading is not what is meant, the AI's inference); it evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.

detail.zh: 复用列出（Listed）、普查（Web.Census）与平衡的证明：跨步保持的成员在两张列表上计数相同（marks_le_of_sub），平衡 Listed.across 现由 Listed.keeps 推出。
detail.en: Reuses listing (Listed), the census (Web.Census) and the proof of the balance: the members kept are counted alike on both lists (marks_le_of_sub); the balance Listed.across now follows from Listed.keeps.

output.zh: 每个列出的计数满足平衡。
output.en: The counts of every listing balance.

input.zh: 满足平衡（保持的形式）的每组计数都被某个列出实现。
input.en: Every set of counts in balance, in the kept form, is realized by some listing.

detail.zh: 复用计数（comings、ceasings、mark、mark_iff、mark_pos、mark_le_one）、开始与不再成立（ComesToBe、CeasesToBe）与步段（steps_last、steps_mem）。
detail.en: Reuses the counts (comings, ceasings, mark, mark_iff, mark_pos, mark_le_one), coming and ceasing to be (ComesToBe, CeasesToBe) and stretches (steps_last, steps_mem).

output.zh: 开始成立与不再成立的计数。
output.en: Counts of coming and ceasing to be.

detail.zh: 复用八个前提、普查与有界传递（World.Counted、World.Transmitting）以及什么都不流动时前提空成立（World.still_vacuous）。
detail.en: Reuses the eight premises, a census and bounded transmission (World.Counted, World.Transmitting), and the premises holding vacuously where nothing flows (World.still_vacuous).

detail.zh: 复用体现（Web.Embodied）与经由另一个活跃者的给予而生起（Web.Embodied.arises_given）。
detail.en: Reuses embodiment (Web.Embodied) and arising through another active relatum's giving (Web.Embodied.arises_given).

output.zh: 平衡且只有活跃者给予时，体现的生起者由一个活跃的关系项给予。
output.en: With balance and only active relata giving, an embodied relatum arising is given by an active relatum.

input.zh: 没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起。
input.en: Nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active.

conditions.zh: 平衡；只有活跃者给予；生起者体现；普查。
conditions.en: Balance; only active relata giving; whatever arises embodied; a census.

detail.en: Reuses closure and dissipation (Flow.ClosedAt, Flow.DissipatesOn, Flow.Dissipative).

output.zh: 耗散只约束有封闭的有限家族的步。
output.en: Dissipation binds only at steps with a closed finite family.

input.zh: 队首活跃时与每个地关系项交换，没有有限家族封闭，耗散空成立；队空时什么都不交换。
input.en: With the front active exchanging with every ground relatum no finite family is closed and dissipation holds vacuously; with the queue empty nothing is exchanged.

detail.zh: 复用世界（World）、什么都不流动的流（Flow.still）与世界的前提。
detail.en: Reuses worlds (World), the still flow (Flow.still) and the premises of worlds.

detail.zh: 证明改经一步的规律：取用对计数的约束（World.taking_binds_counting）。
detail.en: The proofs now go through the laws of one step: binding of counting by taking (World.taking_binds_counting).

output.zh: 跨过没有从平衡的家族取用的一步，家族上的耗散排除成员上升。
output.en: Across a step at which nothing is taken from a balanced family, dissipation on the family excludes a member rising.

input.zh: 没有关系项活跃的一步上没有什么被取用，所以没有生起。
input.en: Nothing is taken across a step at which nothing is active, so nothing arises.

conditions.zh: 平衡；只有活跃者取用；耗散；体现。
conditions.en: Balance; only active relata taking; dissipation; embodiment.

detail.zh: 计划 P34：对计数给出整体规律的完整清单；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Plan P34: the complete list of the whole's laws, for counting; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: 静止定理是平衡、耗散、体现与被围住一起对计数的约束。
detail.en: The rest theorem is a constraint on counting by balance, dissipation, embodiment and enclosure together.

detail.zh: 被围住时与有限世界中计数的规律：计数表、没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起，再加一个变化界。
detail.en: The laws of counting under enclosure and in finite worlds: the tally and nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active, with a change bound.

detail.zh: 同一个展开中所立者与依存的计数规律：不被围住时所立者的规律就是活动的，依存的计数不受前提约束。
detail.en: The laws of counting what stands and what depends in the same unfolding: where nothing is enclosed those of what stands are those of activity, and the counts of dependence are not bound by the premises.

detail.zh: 以标记计数恰是已定之处的计数：计数存在恰当所计数者已定，判定程序的标记之和就是计数。
detail.en: Counting by marks is counting where decided: a count exists exactly where what it counts is decided, and a decision procedure's marks sum to the count.

detail.zh: Queue.lone_tally 与 World.queue、World.embodiedQueue：一个关系项从无到有地生起，满足除体现外或除平衡外的全部前提，所以“没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起”不是计数的规律，只在平衡与体现一起之下成立。
detail.en: Queue.lone_tally with World.queue and World.embodiedQueue: one relatum arising from none, meeting every premise but embodiment or every premise but balance, so ‘nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active’ is no law of counting and holds only under balance and embodiment together.

detail.zh: balance_not_tally：每步零个在列、一个不再成立、一个开始成立满足平衡而不是计数表，没有列出有这样的计数；所以全部规律是计数表，不是平衡的等式。
detail.en: balance_not_tally: none listed, with one ceasing and one coming at every step, balances and is no tally, and no listing has these counts; so the whole law is the tally, not the balance equation.

detail.zh: World.openQueue_not_binds 与 World.binds_adds：premised_counting 的见证中耗散、活动需要支持与有界传递空成立；只取每个前提都起约束的世界，每个普查都计到某个生起，这在八个前提之下不是规律。
detail.en: World.openQueue_not_binds and World.binds_adds: in the witness of premised_counting dissipation, activity needing support and bounded transmission hold vacuously; restricted to worlds in which every premise binds, every census counts an arising, which is no law under the eight.

detail.zh: World.drivenQueue 与 World.openQueue_holds：选中平衡、体现与耗散，而只有活跃者给予与只有活跃者取用都不选时，由不活跃的地关系项驱动的队列实现每个计数表；选中平衡、体现与只有活跃者取用，而只有活跃者给予与耗散都不选时，开放的队列实现每个计数表。所以第二条路线的取用与耗散缺一不可。
detail.en: World.drivenQueue and World.openQueue_holds: with balance, embodiment and dissipation selected but neither only active relata giving nor only active relata taking, the queue driven by an inactive ground relatum counts every tally; with balance, embodiment and only active relata taking selected but neither only active relata giving nor dissipation, the open queue counts every tally. So the second route needs both taking and dissipation.

detail.zh: World.binding_counting：只闭合一次的队列满足全部八个前提且每个都起约束，实现每个有某个生起、且没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起的计数表；所以三个前提在开放的队列中空成立（World.openQueue_not_binds）并没有藏起更多的计数规律。起约束只是条件有实例：这个队列中活动需要支持与有界传递对任何活动、任何流都成立（OnceClosedQueue.dependent_any_activity、OnceClosedQueue.transmits_any_flow）。
detail.en: World.binding_counting: queues closed once meet all eight premises with each binding and count every tally with something arising and nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active; so the three premises holding vacuously in the open queue (World.openQueue_not_binds) hide no further law of counting. Binding is only an instance of each condition: in this queue activity needing support and bounded transmission hold whatever is active and whatever flows (OnceClosedQueue.dependent_any_activity, OnceClosedQueue.transmits_any_flow).

detail.zh: World.Finite.not_binds 与 World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census：没有有限世界使每个前提都起约束；去掉闲置的地关系项的 hatch 是有限世界，满足八个前提，除普查外每个前提都起约束。所以 binding_counting 只涉及不有限的世界；有限世界中除普查外每个前提都起约束时的规律由 World.finite_binding_counting 给出。
detail.en: World.Finite.not_binds and World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census: no finite world binds every premise; hatch without its idle ground is a finite world meeting the eight in which every premise but the census binds. So binding_counting concerns worlds that are not finite; the laws in finite worlds where every premise but the census binds are given by World.finite_binding_counting.

detail.zh: World.binding_activity_iff、World.binding_arising_iff 与 World.binding_joint_iff：没有选中活动需要支持、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用与体现时，什么都不发生的计数表由一个所选前提都起约束的世界（传递）实现；不选体现时，每步一个关系项、没有生起与止息的计数表如此；选中体现而选择既不约束计数、也不同时选中只有活跃者给予与有界传递时，一个关系项在第一步从无到有地生起并留下（Queue.lone），生起之步上没有关系项活跃。所以起约束所加的三条各自只在所说的选择之下是规律。
detail.en: World.binding_activity_iff, World.binding_arising_iff and World.binding_joint_iff: where none of activity needing support, only active relata giving, only active relata taking and embodiment is selected, the tally in which nothing happens is counted by a world (a relay) in which each selected premise binds; without embodiment, so is the tally with one relatum at every step and nothing arising or ceasing; with embodiment but a selection neither binding counting nor selecting both only active relata giving and bounded transmission, one relatum arises from none across the first step and stays (Queue.lone), nothing being active at the step it arises. So each of the three laws binding adds is a law only under the selections named.

limitations.zh: 只对离散步与每步有限的成立者陈述；要求可判定（逻辑承诺）与逐点（代替函数外延性）；只说计数，不说哪个成员进入或离开，也不说关系；队列世界的关系项无限多，每个只生起一次；有限世界中与被围住时计数的规律见 counting-under-enclosure；读于世界只陈述了活动的计数，水平与依存的计数由一般的 counting_laws 给出，前提之下的规律见 counting-standing-and-dependence；全部八个前提之下与每个选择之下计数的规律已给出；选择之下的见证都有无限多个关系项，有限世界中每个选择之下的规律见 counting-under-enclosure；其范围包括前提空成立的世界：开放的队列中耗散、活动需要支持与有界传递都空成立（World.openQueue_not_binds），每个前提都起约束时计数的全部规律已给出，只多出有某个生起（World.binding_counting），每个选择之下所选前提都起约束时的规律（World.binding_counting_under）与有限世界中除普查外每个前提都起约束时的规律（World.finite_binding_counting）也已给出，前者的见证有无限多个关系项，有限世界中每个选择之下所选前提都起约束时的规律见 counting-under-enclosure（World.finite_binding_counting_under）；起约束是条件有实例：在只闭合一次的队列中活动需要支持与有界传递对任何活动、任何流都成立，排除表示所允许者的更强的起约束读法之下的规律没有陈述，这一读法由 Ren 选择；只闭合一次的队列与其他见证的依存网是饱和的，即最弱的（每个关系项以其所立的水平依存于每个关系项，Web.saturated），有损的队列不平衡，传递不体现，它们只用作见证；不评价生起或止息；名称（Tally、Queue、Pointwise、CountsObey、openQueue、drivenQueue、onceClosedQueue、Premise、Meets、BindsCounting、saturated、lossyQueue、relayQueue 等）是 AI 按 Ren 10 月 10 日的命名标准所选（零公理部分用描述抽象动力学的形式词，社会与金融词汇不作首选），读法仍由 Ren 选择。
limitations.en: Stated for discrete steps and holders finitely many at each step; needs decidability (a logical commitment) and pointwise properties (in place of function extensionality); speaks only of counts, saying neither which member enters or leaves nor anything of relations; the queue worlds have infinitely many relata, each arising once; the laws of counting in finite worlds and under enclosure are in counting-under-enclosure; read of worlds only the counting of activity is stated, the counts of standing and dependence being covered by the general counting_laws, and their laws under the premises being in counting-standing-and-dependence; the laws of counting under all eight premises and under each selection of them are given; the witnesses under the selections all have infinitely many relata, the laws under each selection in finite worlds being in counting-under-enclosure; the range includes worlds in which premises hold vacuously: in the open queue dissipation, activity needing support and bounded transmission all hold vacuously (World.openQueue_not_binds), and the whole law of counting where every premise binds is given, adding only that something arises (World.binding_counting), and the laws where the premises of each selection bind (World.binding_counting_under) and in finite worlds where every premise but the census binds (World.finite_binding_counting) are given as well, the witnesses of the former having infinitely many relata, and the laws in finite worlds where the premises of each selection bind are in counting-under-enclosure (World.finite_binding_counting_under); binding is an instance of each condition: in the queue closed once activity needing support and bounded transmission hold whatever is active and whatever flows, and the laws under a stronger reading of binding, in which each premise excludes something the representation allows, are not stated, that reading being Ren's to choose; the webs of the queue closed once and the other witnesses are saturated, the weakest (every relatum depending on every relatum at what it stands at, Web.saturated), the lossy queue is unbalanced and the relay not embodied, and they serve only as witnesses; evaluates neither arising nor ceasing; the names (Tally, Queue, Pointwise, CountsObey, openQueue, drivenQueue, onceClosedQueue, Premise, Meets, BindsCounting, saturated, lossyQueue, relayQueue and others) are the AI's choice under Ren's naming criteria of 10 October (in the zero-axiom part, formal words describing the abstract dynamics, social and financial words not the first choice), and readings remain Ren's.
